qualityWorkspace.title: Data quality
qualityWorkspace.description: Find missing or invalid product details and see which listings need attention.

summary.label: Catalog checks by surface
summary.title: Without blockers or warnings
summary.count: {count, plural, one {# active product checked} other {# active products checked}}
summary.breakdown: {blocker} with blockers, {warning} with warnings, {info} with advisories only, {ready} with no findings.

method.title: How this works
method.description: These checks inspect saved active-product data against our rule registry. They do not confirm live storefront access or acceptance by Google or ChatGPT. Advisory-only products count as having no blockers or warnings.

qualityWorkspace.issuesHint: Blockers come first, followed by warnings and advisories. Within each group, issues affecting more products come first. A product may appear under several issues.
qualityWorkspace.noFindings: No findings for this product within the selected checks.

empty.title: No active products to check
empty.description: These checks cover active products only. Draft and archived products stay in your catalog, but are not included here.

error.title: The quality checks could not load
error.description: Your catalog is still saved. Try loading the findings again.

clear.title: No findings for these checks
clear.description: The active products pass the recorded checks for this view. This does not confirm acceptance by a shopping platform.

noMatches.title: No matching findings or products
noMatches.description: Try another search or clear the filters to see the full list.
